unit: U4 harmonic trees to granule (camera unit C: Sh4 + Sh5 falling pellets)

scions_applied.6 Whitney Harmonic Motion Orchestra: oscillator bank, common period, measured alignment, phase visualizer, locked vs detuned A/B, sparse->dense->release
scions_applied.7 Foldes Drawn Metamorphosis: one continuous per-frame transformation per tree, shape identity kept: whole -> beads at fixed pitch -> cut -> the cut pieces are the pellets -> orbits -> fall; no dissolves
scions_applied.44 Multiplane: planes: blue practicals 0.3x, back trees 0.5x (scale 0.5, defocus sigma 3.2, gain 0.62), front trees 1.0x in 2 sub-depths; lateral camera glide 30 px smoothstep over the shot
scions_applied.8 Sutherland constraint / 29 GrabCut: not re-applied here: vocabulary is read from U2's constraint-derived geometry.json; the heap is U2's GrabCut cutout

sh4.format: 960x408 picture band only, no captions/letterbox/grain (editor applies the shared grain via kit.py)

sh5_pellet_layer.landing: 34 pellets (the 34 with the latest release in Sh4, keeping their own cut shapes and dyes) fall from above the band from 35.00-35.62 s, land on the heap surface measured from cutout/sh5/heap_rgba_960x408.png alpha (>128, closed 9 px, blurred 6 px) +2..9 px, one bounce (restitution 0.25), 0.15 s slide, then rest. Composite: heap*(1-a)+rgb*a with the heap at offset (0,0) of the same 960x408 band.

deliverables.build_scripts: films/swarm/le-chant-du-styrene/harmonic-build/ (trees.py model+renderer, render.py sh4/sh5/measure/ab/phase, compare.py, stats.py, worms.py, preview.py)

formulas.time_base: tau = t - 27.60 s; P = 33.60 - 27.60 = 6.0 s; Omega = 2*pi/P = 1.047198 rad/s; omega_i = n_i * Omega with integer n_i in {1,2,3}
formulas.branch_swing: theta_ik(t) = A_k * env(t) * sin(k * omega_i * tau), A_k = 7 deg / sqrt(k), env = smoothstep(tau/1.2 s); level k of tree i swings at k*omega_i
formulas.forward_kinematics: trunk segment above node k rotates by Phi_k = sum_{j<=k} 0.3*theta_ij; side branches/twigs/discs at node k rotate by Phi_k + theta_ik about the posed node
formulas.beading: radius r(s) * [(1-beta) + beta*(0.10 + 1.18*((1+cos(2*pi*(s-s0)/p))/2)^0.8)], fixed pitch p = 13 px (6.5 px back plane), beta = smoothstep over 1.35 s from 31.00 + stagger_i; at beta=1 the necks are 0.10 r and the strand is cut there
formulas.pellet: pellet j = the strand samples with |s - s_j| <= p/2 around bead centre s_j, with their own radii (the literal piece of the tree), necks closed by sqrt taper; moved rigidly
formulas.orbit: d_j(t) = R_j * e(t) * [cos(m_j*omega_i*tau + psi_j) - cos psi_j, sin(m_j*omega_i*tau + psi_j) - sin psi_j]; m_j in {+-1,+-2,+-3} (p .45/.35/.20), psi_j ~ U(0,2pi), R_j lognormal(median 22 px, sigma .45) clipped 7..55 px; e = smoothstep((t - t_cut)/0.35 s). d_j = 0 at tau = 0 and tau = P exactly (integer m_j*n_i)
formulas.spacing_jitter: home_j = strand point + e*(jit_t*tangent + jit_n*normal), jit_t ~ N(0, 0.28 p), jit_n ~ N(0, 2.2 px); spin = spin_j*e*sin(m_j*omega_i*tau), spin_j ~ N(0,70 deg)
formulas.release_fall: after 33.60 + delay_j (delay_j = U^1.3 * 0.78 s) add (vx_j*tf, 0.5*g*tf^2), g = 1400 px/s^2 front, 700 back; the orbit formula keeps running so pellets fly out again as they fall
formulas.light: thickness th = max over stamped spheres 2*sqrt(r^2-d^2); optical depth od = w_i*(th + 4*cov)/10; emission E = 1.02*L*exp(-a*od)*(0.10 + 0.90*nr^1.1) + dyed opal scatter + rim specular from grad(cov*nr), light from upper left; L = (1.0, 0.86, 0.60); amber dye a = (0.10, 0.50, 2.00), crimson dye a = (0.11, 0.95, 1.00); background seen through: bg*(1 - cov + cov*T*(1-opal)*0.85)
formulas.grade: identical to U2 render.py: halation 0.22*blur5 + 0.10*blur16 of pixels with lum > 0.45; roll-off knee 0.66, k + 0.15*tanh((lum-k)/0.15) (max lum ~207). No grain here.

alignment.note: 33.60 s = frame 806.4: no frame lands exactly on it; frame 806 (33.583 s) is the closest (max |theta| 0.88 deg, rms orbit displacement 2.0 px), frame 807 (33.625) 1.30 deg / 3.1 px. Measured on the continuous model: max |theta| = 0 and rms pellet displacement = 0 at 33.600 s; wrapped phase error 1e-14 rad. The branch angles alone also pass through zero at 30.60 s (half period, sin(k n pi) = 0) with mixed velocities, visible as a dip in the visualizer; the full reunion (angles and pellet orbits, which need cos too) happens only at 33.60.

ab_choice.reason: With locked ratios the pellet cloud contracts and reassembles into the dotted outline of every tree at 33.60 s (rms displacement 0 px), so the viewer sees that the grains are pieces of the tree just before they fall: the shape match the proof needs, landing on U1's chord. With detune (n_i(1+eps_i), |eps| 3-8%) the best moment is 33.31 s with max |theta| 6.99 deg and rms displacement 23 px: the cloud never reunites and reads as random confetti, so the release has nothing to release from.

no_worms_check.measure: pairs of pellets adjacent on the same strand whose orbit displacements differ by < 4 px (travelling together), and the CV of their gap
no_worms_check.reading: 1-6% of adjacent pairs travel together during the orbits (no chains); at 33.60 all are home by design (the reunion), with the gap CV at 0.35 from the spacing jitter, so the outline is dotted and irregular rather than an even bead chain

aesthetic_reading: measured at 32.00 s: lum<20 0.73 (bar >= 0.65), p99 191 (user note asks 166-196; bar <= 210), lit median sat 0.89 (bar >= 0.70), red .31 / orange .15 / amber .35 / blue .19 of lit pixels (warm 0.81, blue practical present). The reference band is brighter overall (lum<20 0.54) because its trees are denser and thicker. Perceptually judged by the builder only (not an independent critic): the rods read as lit-through moulded plastic with dark grazing edges, bright cores and rim catches, not as constant-width neon outlines; kf-3's worms and even rods are gone.

evidence.used_as: measurement only: the four arm angles (181/297/9/105 deg -> trunk kink 12 deg, side arms -116/+72 deg halved to -58/+36 deg), the four arm widths (width classes 1.00/0.97/0.67/0.57), disc radius/arm length 0.33 and bore ratio 0.15 shape the handmade trees

handmade.what: 6 front + 5 back translucent runner trees, thickness-field models with moulding noise (radius +-7%, rim +-3.5%), gates necked to 0.55 r before discs, dished discs with bores, V crowns, twig forks
Whitney oscillator bank, 65 oscillators (tree, level), common period 6.0 s
per-frame bead -> cut -> pellet -> orbit -> reunion -> fall, 653 front pellets + 516 back
two defocused blue practical lights, disc at (792,96) r~58 and bar centred (250,128), 0.3x parallax; placed differently from the reference and from U2's Sh1
34 handmade pellets (Sh4's last-released pieces) falling onto the real heap, RGBA layer

declared_choices: Side-branch angles are the measured runner inter-arm angles halved (a declared stylisation toward a tree), alternating per node so the tree is not mirror-symmetric.
Colour is a handmade dye/thickness model (amber or crimson dye per tree), not a substitution of foraged pixels; no foraged image appears in Sh4.
The warm backlight under the plastic is a lighting choice; it is the same model as U2's gel ramp and U3's Beer-Lambert melt.
absences: Moving Image Archive cache searched 'plastic|pellet|granul|grain|hopper|pour' (clips): only slow-motion waves, an hourglass, rain off a gutter, a market; no plastic granule footage or pellet sound, so nothing taken. Sound remains U1's (granular rain stem, chord at 33.60).
No new downloads by this unit (0 MB).
gaps: No independent critic has viewed Sh4; all perceptual statements are the builder's.
The alignment instant 33.600 s falls between frames 806 and 807; frame 806 shows the reunion 2 px rms short of exact.
Back-plane trees are dim (gain 0.62, blur 3.2) and read as a witness layer more than as a second depth plane like the reference's.
Fewer lit pixels than the reference (lum<20 0.73 vs 0.54): the reference trees are denser and thicker; within the plan's bar.
By 34.75 s most pellets have fallen out; the last ~0.2 s before the 35.00 cut is almost empty black with the blue practicals and a few last grains (intended as the release; the editor can trim).
Sh5 pellets are small against the heap granules (they match Sh4 scale, ~10-14 px); they have no contact shadow.
Sh5 RGBA has straight alpha of emitted colour; no light transmission of the heap through the pellets is modelled.
